data.name: Home.ReachOut
data.value: Reach out to us: no account needed, no judgment. Just tell us how we can help.

data.name: About.BelieveAfricanPhilosophyPerson
data.value: We believe in the African philosophy that a person is a person through other persons. Everything we do is grounded in this collective humanity.

data.name: About.EveryIndividualServeTreated
data.value: Every individual we serve is treated with absolute respect and dignity, regardless of their circumstances or background.

data.name: About.LeadEmpathyTeamListens
data.value: We lead with empathy. Our team listens deeply before acting, ensuring our responses are tailored to real needs.

data.name: About.DoNotMerelyProvide
data.value: We do not merely provide services: we build capacity. We want every person we help to become capable of helping others.

data.name: About.TransparentOperationsAccountableCommunities
data.value: We are transparent in our operations, accountable to our communities, and honest in everything we do.

data.name: About.WelcomeAllPeopleRegardless
data.value: We welcome all people regardless of gender, religion, language, or background. Our doors are open to everyone in need.

data.name: About.LearnWhoWhatDrives
data.value: Learn who we are, what drives us, and the values that guide every decision we make.

data.name: About.PhilisaAbafaziBethuMeaning
data.value: Philisa Abafazi Bethu, meaning “heal our women” in isiZulu, was founded in 2009 by a group of determined women in Cape Town's northern suburbs who saw their neighbours suffering without support. What began as a small feeding scheme in a church hall has grown into one of the Western Cape's most comprehensive community welfare organisations.

data.name: About.OverYearsExpandedReach
data.value: Over the years, we expanded our reach from food security to gender-based violence support, youth development, child welfare, and elder care, growing the network of programmes and partners that makes it easier for community members to access our services.

data.name: About.TodayServeOver14
data.value: Today, we serve over 14,200 families annually across 12 communities, powered by a committed team of staff and more than 320 volunteers.

data.name: About.WalkAlongsideCommunitiesTheir
data.value: To walk alongside communities in their most vulnerable moments.

data.name: About.CommittedProvidingAccessibleDignified
data.value: We are committed to providing accessible, dignified, and holistic support services that address the root causes of poverty, inequality, and social exclusion, empowering individuals and families to build sustainable, fulfilling lives.

data.name: About.CommunitiesWhereEveryPerson
data.value: Communities where every person thrives with dignity and hope.

data.name: About.EnvisionSouthAfricaWhere
data.value: We envision a South Africa where no woman is unsafe, no child goes hungry, no elder is forgotten, and no young person is without opportunity: a society where ubuntu is not just a word, but a lived reality.

data.name: About.LucindaEvansDreamProtecting
data.value: Lucinda Evans' dream of protecting and empowering abused women and children became real the day she saw a crowd gather around a man beating his wife in the street; everyone watching, yet no one stepping in to stop it.

data.name: About.SinceThenLucindaHas
data.value: Since then, Lucinda has worked to become the person her community can lean on for protection and reassurance. Based in Lavender Hill, she is determined to ensure that the women and children there always have a place that offers them hope, even in their most difficult circumstances.

data.name: Privacy.Intro
data.value: How Philisa Abafazi Bethu collects, uses, and protects the information you share with us.

data.name: Privacy.WhyBody
data.value: Reaching out for support can already feel difficult. We never want worrying about your privacy to be another barrier. This page explains, in plain language, what information we ask for through this website, why we ask for it, and what happens to it afterwards. We handle your information in line with South Africa's Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

data.name: Privacy.CollectIntro
data.value: We only ask for what we need to understand and respond to you:

data.name: Privacy.CollectSupport
data.value: your name, phone number, email address (if you choose to share it), area, preferred contact method, the type of support you need, and a description of your situation.

data.name: Privacy.CollectContact
data.value: your name, email, phone number, the subject of your message, and the message itself.

data.name: Privacy.NoAccount
data.value: You never need to create an account to request support or get in touch: we deliberately kept account creation out of this platform so that asking for help never feels like a bureaucratic hurdle.

data.name: Privacy.UseBody
data.value: Information you submit is used solely to understand your request, contact you using the method you chose, and connect you with the right person or programme on our team. Situations you describe to us are read only by the staff involved in responding to you, and never shared for marketing, research, or any other purpose without your separate, explicit consent.

data.name: Privacy.ProtectBody
data.value: Your information is stored securely and is only accessible to authorised Philisa Abafazi Bethu staff who need it to help you. We keep it only for as long as necessary to assist you and maintain accurate records of our work, and we do not sell or trade your information to anyone, under any circumstances.

data.name: Privacy.RightsBody
data.value: Under POPIA, you have the right to ask what information we hold about you, to have it corrected if it's wrong, or to ask us to delete it. If you'd like to do any of these, or have any questions about how your information is handled, contact us at

data.name: Privacy.RightsAfter
data.value: and we will respond as quickly as we can.

data.name: Privacy.QuestionsBody
data.value: We're happy to talk you through any of this before you reach out.
